title: Zero explorer
tagline: Discover, verify & interact with Zero-Knowledge (ZK) transactions effortlessly. View proofs, smart contract code, & transaction history. Privacy-focused blockchain explorer.
description: Zero Explorer is a specialized blockchain explorer tailored for Zero-Knowledge (ZK) transactions. It enables users to delve into the intricacies of ZK protocols by offering features such as viewing and verifying smart contract code, examining ZK proofs, and exploring transaction metadata while upholding privacy standards. Users can interact with the system through a user-friendly interface, verifying proofs and conducting searches based on addresses. Additionally, the platform provides graphical representations of transaction history for enhanced understanding. Future iterations may include the manual creation of proofs, further empowering users in the realm of ZK transactions.
how_its_made:
Zero Explorer is built on a foundation of cutting-edge technologies tailored to meet the demands of Zero-Knowledge (ZK) transactions. The project utilizes Next.js as the frontend framework, providing a robust and dynamic user interface. Hardhat serves as the backend, facilitating smart contract interactions and transaction processing.

The integration of Scroll Network enhances privacy and security, ensuring that user data and transaction details remain confidential throughout the exploration process. Circuits email wallet offers seamless interaction with ZK proofs and related smart contract details, streamlining user engagement and verification processes.

A notable aspect of the project lies in its meticulous attention to security and privacy. Leveraging Scroll Network's capabilities, ZK Explorer prioritizes data protection and confidentiality, setting a new standard for privacy-focused blockchain explorers.

In the development process, the team implemented innovative solutions to address complex challenges, ensuring a seamless and intuitive user experience. Through strategic integration of partner technologies and meticulous attention to detail, ZK Explorer stands as a testament to the power of collaboration and innovation in the blockchain space.
